page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Numbered theses XV to XXI, each number centred on its own line and followed by its text. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Catchword "ex" at bottom right.

main_text.p: tis, venales sunt. Tertullianus, Apologetici cap. 13.
De quorundam infirmitatibus habét quod valent, nihil valentes si in benè valentem fidem incurrant. De praescriptionibus, cap. 2.
A Philosophia subornantur. Item. Inserunt Aristotelem qui illis Dialecticam instituit.. &c. cap. 7.
Scripturas obtendunt, & hac sua audacia statim quosdam movent: in ipso verò con-gressu firmos quidem fatigant, infirmos capi-unt, medios cum scrupulo dimittunt.cap. 15.
His nituntur quæ ex falso composuerunt, & quæ de ambiguitate coeperunt.cap. 17.

Solent dicere non omnia Apostolos scisse: eadem agitati dementia qua rursus conver-tunt, omnia quidem Apostolos scisse, sed non omnia omnibus tradidisse, in utroque Christum reprehensioni subiicientes, qui aut minus instructos, aut parum simplices Apostolos miserit. cap. 22.
Credunt sine Scripturis, ut credant adver-sus Scripturas. cap. 23.

page.notes: Spacing in "De praescriptionibus" is hard to judge at the print; it may be run together. "instituit.." appears with a double full stop. The accents on "habét", "benè", "verò" and "ut" are as printed. The catchword "ex" sits below the last line at right. The woodcut-free page shows no marginal notes.
